author: Blackjack_MC
body: I want to appeal my temp-ban... I had shot that footage a while ago and totally forgot what had happened. It is unfair to call it "team griefing" when I was CLEARLY knocked into the void by an enemy player... It was not my intention to kill myself with all of my team's VALUABLE iron... pause the video after I die to see for yourself. It says "Slugbo_1 was knocked out of the world by OnlyOne_Canoli" SEE FOR YOURSELF!!! I was ACTUALLY trying to put all of the iron in chests to make it more accessible for my teammates, when I was ambushed by an enemy and knocked into the void.
